description: Fix capacity poller to include us-west-2b (the AZ where B300 was previously acquired) and add PD config to b300-run-config.sh
steps: In scripts/poll-b300-h200.sh, add us-west-2b to SUBNET_MAP: SUBNET_MAP["us-west-2b"]="subnet-0594a48bad1aef4a6"

In scripts/poll-b300-h200.sh, add two new entries to TARGETS array (one for H200, one for B300) for us-west-2b, inserted alongside the other us-west-2 entries: 'p5en.48xlarge us-west-2 us-west-2b 35 scripts/recipes/h200-tp4-fp4-eagle.env' and 'p6-b300.48xlarge us-west-2 us-west-2b 60 scripts/recipes/b300-tp2-dp2-fp4-megamoe.env'
Update the log line in the main loop that lists regions to include us-west-2b: change 'us-west-2 (2a,2c,2d)' to 'us-west-2 (2a,2b,2c,2d)'
In scripts/b300-run-config.sh, add a new config 'pd-3p1d-nixl' in the resolve_config() case statement (after c1b-tp8-megamoe-noeagle, before the *) wildcard)

The pd-3p1d-nixl config needs a fundamentally different approach since PD requires multiple engines + router, not a single container. Set CONFIG_DESC to describe 3P1D with nixl transfer. Set CONFIG_IMAGE to v0.5.17-cu130. Set CONFIG_ENV_ARGS with -e SGLANG_OPT_DEEPGEMM_MEGA_MOE_NUM_MAX_TOKENS_PER_RANK=16384 -e SGLANG_DISAGGREGATION_WAITING_TIMEOUT=1800 -e SGLANG_DISAGGREGATION_BOOTSTRAP_TIMEOUT=1800. Set CONFIG_SERVE_ARGS to a special marker value '--pd-compose' that the launch step can detect to use docker compose instead of docker run.
Add the pd-3p1d-nixl config to the list_configs_indented() function with appropriate description

Add a comment block above the new config explaining that this config uses docker-compose-pd-v4flash-b300.yaml instead of single-container docker run, and the launch/readiness/bench steps will need to handle this differently (Phase 1+ work)
acceptance_criteria: TARGETS array has entries for us-west-2b (both p5en and p6-b300)
The new config uses v0.5.17-cu130 image and 16384 env var
verification: grep 'us-west-2b' scripts/poll-b300-h200.sh | wc -l should be >= 3 (subnet + 2 targets)
grep 'pd-3p1d-nixl' scripts/b300-run-config.sh | wc -l should be >= 2 (case + list)
